summary: Fire lookout on the summit of Mount Manuel Quimper in Sea to Sea Regional Park near Sooke, BC; built 1951 (CRD says 1950s), recently refurbished, open to the public.

facts.agency: Capital Regional District (park); built by the BC Forest Service

access.note: Publicly accessible per Visit Sooke and Trailpeak, within Sea to Sea Regional Park. Trailpeak gives the park reserve as open sunrise to sunset and the parking lot as 8 am to 6 pm.

visit.trail_note: Hike or bike from the Harbourview Road entrance. The CRD gives 5.6 km to the summit; Trailpeak gives 4.3 km one way. Trailpeak describes the foot path to the tower as very steep.

events.note: Trailpeak gives 1951; the CRD says built by the BC Forest Service in the 1950s

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The CRD gives 5.6 km to the summit; Trailpeak gives 4.3 km one way. The story reports both and does not choose.
Trailpeak gives 1951 and the CRD says the 1950s. These agree; the story uses 1951 and keeps the CRD's wording.

notes_for_editor: No staffing, fire or retirement history was found in two searches and six reads, so the story says nothing on those. The Waymarking page is JavaScript only and returned no text. Trailpeak's 1951 is the only exact date. The brief's source (OpenStreetMap) adds nothing. A local heritage or BC Forest Service report could add the staffing history.
